method: Country-specific piecewise annual histories grounded in federation history and temporally gated current development/competition structures.
evidence_rules: Colombia's 1932 federation history anchors institutional continuity; 2025 Interligas/training-site and 2026 affiliation/child-circuit evidence is not backcast.
Mexico's 1894 club history and 1963 FMT foundation anchor tradition; current affiliation, association and national junior-circuit data is gated to 2025/2026.
Affiliation and event-participation counts are not treated as total tennis participation.
Competition quality uses organised competition opportunity and system depth rather than direct conversion of star-player results.
Approximate and stage-specific counts keep their scope limitations in provenance.
No held-out validation ranking is used for tuning.
